posts.title: AI-Optimized Marketing Engine for Apex Retail
posts.description:
Elevating Apex Marketing

Our team implemented advanced custom machine-learning bidding models for Apex Retail. Over a 90-day testing cycle, the campaign returned amazing results.

  • 🎯 142% Increase in organic client clicks.
  • 💰 32% Drop in Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
  • ⚡ Automated copy generating hundreds of variations in real-time.

The platform runs on Express and utilizes Google Search models to adjust budgets every 3 minutes.
